boundary: Negacyclicity is an algebraic clock/code gauge, not a physical arrow of time. The comparison to Pass 9961-9984 is a shared Phi_8 reciprocal-factor and hyperbolic-pair mechanism; it does not identify the two carriers as the same representation, nor does it promote the finite clock to continuum time.

theorem: The exact Pass 10946 clock tetracode has two and only two distinct standard negacyclic images in its signed-permutation orbit. They are the principal ideals generated by the reciprocal irreducible factors x^2+x-1 and x^2-x-1 of Phi_8=x^4+1 over F3. Each image is a self-dual [4,2,3]_3 tetracode on which the negacyclic shift has order eight; the two images intersect only at zero, pair nondegenerately with one another, and are exchanged by cyclotomic inversion. Thus the four-ray clock code and the repo's Pass 9961-9984 reciprocal-prime split are the same finite algebraic mechanism at different module ranks, not merely the same factor count.
